title: fix(console): the publish-all probe warning shows a finding's userMessage, never its agent message
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8AJJJRiYjshMUNgyMZSqBsr)_

Fixes #34553

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：首页「全部发布」和草稿预览条的「发布」在运行检查发现错误时，提示「已发布，但校验发现问题」下方的说明不再原样打印写给 AI 的英文 `message`。错误带有客户句（`userMessage`）时显示这句话；都没带时，显示 AI 对话发布健康行在同样情况下显示的通用句（`chatbot.build.issuesSummary`，来自语言包）。`message` 和 `fix` 不再进入提示。
- 为什么改：#32984 Q1 裁决：面向用户的文字显示 `userMessage`，永不显示开发者的 `message`。对话里的健康行已按此改好（#34539），这个提示还没改。
- 风险与回滚：只改提示说明的取值，标题、成功提示、示例数据提示和失败提示都不变；不新增语言包键、不改导出。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。卡片点名的第二处 `PendingDraftsBar` 在当前 main 上已经不再发布、也没有任何提示（见 Acceptance notes），本 PR 不改它。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts` 里 `probeProblems` 的取值和 `toast.warning` 的 `description`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/usePublishAllDrafts.userMessage-34553.test.tsx`，预期 6 个用例全部通过（en 与 zh-Hans 各 3 个）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`usePublishAllDrafts` (shared by Home's *Publish all* and the draft-preview bar) collected the error-severity probe findings as their `message` strings and printed the first as the detail of the "Published, but verification found problems." warning. It now keeps the findings themselves and gives the toast:

- the `userMessage` of the first error that carries one: the producer's sentence for the person who published, already in the request's language; else
- `t('chatbot.build.issuesSummary')`, the generic sentence the chat's `PublishHealthLine` shows for an error set whose findings carry no `userMessage`.

`message` and `fix` reach no user-facing text. The findings are read through the existing `publishHealthFromResponse` reader from `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core`, which already reads `userMessage`. No second reader is written, and no locale key is added.

Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

New file `usePublishAllDrafts.userMessage-34553.test.tsx`: the real hook, the real client and health reader, and `I18nProvider` with the shipped packs. Three cases, each run in `en` and `zh-Hans`:

1. An error with a `userMessage`: the detail is that sentence, and contains neither `message` nor `fix`.
2. An error with no `userMessage`: the detail is the pack's `chatbot.build.issuesSummary`, read from the shipped `en` / `zh` pack objects, and not `message`.
3. An unvoiced error ahead of a voiced one: the voiced sentence is shown.

It is its own file because `I18nProvider` installs a module-level i18next global, which would leak into the key-echo `t` the other `usePublishAllDrafts` pins use.

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise, half held.** The hook's toast printed `issues[].message`, as the card says. `PendingDraftsBar` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/PendingDraftsBar.tsx`) no longer publishes on `origin/main`: since the one-Publish change of #34610 it only counts drafts and points to the shell's bar, and it imports no `toast` and reads no publish health. Its publish now goes through this hook, so this change covers it.
- The toast holds one detail line. It shows the first voiced error, the first row the health line shows for the same set; it does not list several findings.
- The generic sentence ends "Reply \"fix the problems\" and the assistant will repair them." In the chat that is an instruction the user can follow; on Home's *Publish all* there is no assistant thread next to the toast. The card's ruling says to use #34539's choice for an issue with no `userMessage`, so this PR uses it unchanged. Whether the Home toast should get its own sentence is a question for the seat.
- Out of scope, unchanged: the seed-failure detail still prints the producer's `seedError` text when one is sent, and the package-less by-reference loop still builds `NAME: sample data failed to load` in English. The chat's health line shows only the localized sentence there. The issue is reported to the seat, not handled here.
